Use Proxy → Home → Restart services to rebuild connections without closing the program, especially after waking your laptop or changing networks.
For account errors, refresh the cookie after signing in again for 401 or 403; for 429, wait or add a second account.
Press ++Ctrl+R++ to reload an odd-looking interface without losing data.
If nothing helps, collect the Proxy log error, the Server log tab and, for a failed start, `startup-error.log`; these logs exclude cookies and keys and are safe to share.

voice.tldr: **Voice and MemuAI Live** lets you dictate messages, have answers read aloud, and hold real-time voice conversations with AI models. Configure all speech recognition, text-to-speech engines, and Live model providers in **Settings → Voice & Live**.
points: Dictation uses either a local Whisper model for offline privacy or an **Audio API** service, with optional **Post-processing** to fix punctuation and filler words before sending.
Read any answer aloud via the message menu → **Read aloud**, choosing from system voices, downloaded Piper voices, or cloud TTS services; cached audio is not billed twice.
MemuAI Live opens a voice conversation saved to the current chat, supporting camera, screen sharing, web search, and custom instructions via **Live personality and presets**.
Real-time Live models like GPT-Live and Gemini Live listen and speak directly without transcription pauses, configured by enabling **Use a real-time model in MemuAI Live** and pasting a provider key.
API keys are stored locally in the MemuAI data folder, and the microphone and Live buttons can be hidden from the composer using the corresponding toggles.

web-search.tldr: Web search gives models fresh information beyond their training date, useful for news, rates, timetables and documentation of new versions. MemuAI can use a model’s built-in search or pass external search results to any text model.
points: Enable search for the current chat with the top-bar toggle or `/search on`; an `@Web` mention suggests checking the internet for a particular question.
Use **Settings → Web search → Enable by default** for new chats, but remember that the chat toggle takes precedence and the model still decides whether search is needed.
Choose Automatic, Built-in only or Custom only under Settings → Web search → Search source, and right-click the chat toggle to choose the source from the chat.
Configure external services under Settings → Web search → External source → Service, then use Test the source to check results and speed; API keys stay on this computer.
Configure search for third-party API programs separately under Proxy → Settings → Web search, which works independently of MemuAI’s settings.

welcome.tldr: MemuAI is a Windows desktop application that unifies cloud AI accounts (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok) and local models into one window for conversations, files, voice, memory and scheduling. Use it when you want to manage all your AI services and offline models from a single interface.
points: **MemuAI** is the chat window for conversations, Work, MemuCode and settings, while **MemuAI Proxy** runs in the tray as the background engine that stores accounts and serves the API.
Start by following the setup order: install the program, connect at least one service or local model via Accounts, learn the Interface, then begin using Chats and Models.
Search the documentation with the field at the top left or the ++/++ key, navigate history with ++Alt+←++ and ++Alt+→++, and select any text to ask MemuAI about it directly.
All chats, settings, memory and accounts are stored locally on your computer in `%APPDATA%\MemuAI`, and messages are sent only to the selected service or stay entirely offline for local models.
The app includes specialized sections like Agents for parallel tasks, MemuCode for programmers, Voice for dictation and live conversation, and Modules for custom HTML, CSS and JavaScript apps.

work.tldr: **Work** is the mode where the model reads, writes, and edits files within a single chosen project folder on your computer. Use it for documents, texts, small sites, and scripts by clicking the **Work** button in the sidebar or typing `/work`.
points: Add folders with the ＋ button on the Work bar; each project has its own chats, and the model sees only files inside that folder.
Choose between **Ask for approval** (default) and **Full access** via the Work bar switch or `/access`; changes are always visible in chat.
Use **Plan** (`/plan` or `@Plan`) to make the model outline verifiable steps before working, or **Goal** (`/goal <goal>`) for autonomous step-by-step execution up to 12 turns.
Keep **Confirm CLI commands** enabled in Settings → Work & agents so the model asks before running commands with your Windows account rights.
Reference specific files directly with `@path`, and use the preview panel on the right when the model creates web pages.
